description.value: Masa's Bar + Grill is a casual restaurant and bar situated in the Village Day Lodge at Sun Peaks Resort, BC's second-largest four-season mountain resort. It claims the largest selection of draft beer at Sun Peaks with 20 taps including local craft brews, and serves a menu of fresh-made appetizers, salads, mains, and kids' favourites. The relaxed space — with a fireplace, big screens, and a pool table — makes it a natural post-ride destination for cyclists finishing a day on Sun Peaks' extensive bike park and trail network.
